picks.question: Will inflation reach more than 4.5% in 2026?
picks.why: A return to inflation above 4.5% would upend expectations for interest rates, real wages, and bond markets.

picks.question: Will OpenAI’s market cap be $1.5T or greater at market close on IPO day by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: An OpenAI IPO valued at $1.5 trillion or more would test how public markets price AI's expected future profits.

picks.question: Will an AI lab announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2026?
picks.why: An AI lab solving a Millennium Prize problem would signal that machines can now produce frontier mathematical research.

picks.question: OpenAI announces it has achieved AGI before 2027?
picks.why: A formal AGI claim by OpenAI could affect its contracts, regulatory scrutiny, and investor expectations across the technology sector.

picks.question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
picks.why: Leadership continuity in China shapes global trade, supply chains, and policy toward the world's second-largest economy.

picks.question: Will J.D. Vance win the 2028 Republican presidential nomination?
picks.why: Who leads the Republican ticket in 2028 will shape expectations for trade, fiscal, and industrial policy.
